title: The treatment-side booking write has no operation, no element names and no state value in the S2 sources, and the difference column has no shape
source: Legacy RWB-E2-007 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epic 2 Story Files v5/RWB E2 007 Booking confirmation from the ALS load v2.md), sections 4, 7, 9, 11, 12 and 13; FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 T-A of the TSD pair, A2.1 to A2.18, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T1, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-03, DP-04, DP-13 and R7.2
section: 1 Story; 2 Business rationale; 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC7; 8 Business rules; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.5; 12.7; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: One combined row for the story. (1) No S2 source carries the booking confirmation: the FSD S2 decomposition A2.1 to A2.18 and the TSD S2 appendix T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004) contain no approved-not-booked read, no mark-booked write and no booking-difference write, because the legacy story sat in the P2 Integration module; the four operations of T-A.1 are the treatment resource, the terms change, the submit and the offer only. (2) The operation names and the payload element names of the three calls are therefore this story design and are fixed by no source. (3) The treatment state BOOKED is named by no list: TSD S2 T3.2 gives LOV-TRT-OUTCOME (KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED, DECLINED) and no LOV for the standard state column of T3.0, so the state value and its check constraint are a working read. (4) The legacy booked_at is DF-TRT-012 timestamptz and booking_difference is DF-TRT-028 jsonb, and no source states the keys or the value types inside the difference, so the approved-and-booked term shape is a working read. (5) No source fixes the nullability of the two columns at booking time or the uniqueness of a confirmation per treatment and business date. (6) The FSD S2 field catalog does not list the booking elements for SCR-14, and the screen field list is not published with the service.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (DF-TRT-012, DF-TRT-028), T3.2 (no state list, LOV-TRT-OUTCOME without BOOKED) and T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004 only); FSD S2 v3 Screens (SCR-14 names the booking confirmation and lists no field); legacy RWB-E2-007 sections 11 and 13 (columns added by the treatment owner, no P2 table)
owner_role: Solution architect, S2, with the rwb-treatment tech lead and the gateway-bff owner
proposed: The treatment contract baseline of RWB-S2-E3001-CON adds the three operations and their element names at the wave 2 contract freeze; the standard state column gains a check constraint with APPROVED and BOOKED among its values; booking_difference is a jsonb object keyed by term name with the approved and the booked value of each; one confirmation exists per treatment and business date, enforced by a unique key on the local record of the booking.

title: The rwb-treatment share of the key is stated by no S2 source, the P2 contract shapes it follows are unpublished, and the trigger, the task-raising and the event ownership are split across stories
source: Legacy RWB-E2-007 sections 4, 7, 10, 12 and 16; Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 and R5.7; _work/msr/context/S2.md (S2 ownership rows: four REST operations, one event EV-10, no jobs, one workflow); Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1 RWB P2 E2007 APP and CON (the integration side of the same legacy key)
section: 1 Story; 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 5 Exception paths; 8 Business rules; 10 Authority; 12.2; 12.3; 12.4; 12.6; 12.8; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages; 18 Traceability; 19 Out of scope
description: One combined row for the split. (1) The split is the one RWB-P2-E2007-APP states in its own section 1, and no S2 source states which part of legacy RWB-E2-007 the treatment service keeps, so the boundary is read from the sibling story and recorded here. (2) The shapes, the outcome codes, the booking-reference rule and the fakes of the two writes belong to RWB-P2-E2007-CON, which is not published at the time of writing, so this story builds against the fakes and the operation names stay open (see CG-B2-S2-016-1). (3) JOB-08, its event trigger and its rerun operation belong to rwb-integration (the S2 ownership rows give the service no job), so the trigger is stated by that story and this story registers no Schedule and runs no Quartz job; the wait between batches is a durable timer bounded by booking.missing.grace_loads, and the parameter codes read through DP-06 are not published. (4) The tasks WITH_OPS_BOOKING, WITH_OPS_SETTLEMENT and UNMATCHED_EXCEPTION, the route states and the case-side record are rwb-case share, and the legacy messages MSG-P2-011 and MSG-P2-012 are rendered by the parent from the stage outcome; no S2 source states this. (5) TreatmentBooked (EV-11) is published by rwb-payment in the legacy while EV-10 is the one event the S2 ownership row grants, so this story publishes no treatment event type of its own and the library record publication is the only event it writes. (6) The REC-03 result and the run summary stay with rwb-integration and rwb-source-data, so no reconciliation_result row is written here.
evidence: _work/msr/context/S2.md ownership rows (REST 4, events 1 EV-10, jobs 0, workflow TreatmentWorkflow); RWB P2 E2007 APP section 1 (the treatment record, its APPROVED to BOOKED state, booked_at, the booking difference and the treatment-side decision record are the S2 story of this legacy key) and section 4 step 9 (the mark-booked and difference writes of the rwb-treatment contract); Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 DP-10 and DP-19, R5.7
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-integration, rwb-treatment and rwb-case tech leads and the platform workflow owner
proposed: The split is confirmed as written in this story when RWB-P2-E2007-CON is published; the parameter codes booking.missing.grace_loads and the treatment-type and outcome list codes are added to the parameters and reference-data registers; the event ownership of TreatmentBooked is recorded in the event catalogue against rwb-payment, and the stage outcome contract of the parent is recorded in the rwb-case contract baseline.
